lines.en: Every step of mine leaves a crater.
My shoulder shoves trees aside.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为我很重
lines.en: I walk slow because I am heavy.
The ground groans under me.
I do not run; I grind forward.
My muscles creak against my bones.
My arms hang to my knees.
This body is wider than a door.
Birds scatter when I walk.
Heavy things have no need to be fast.
I wheeze like a bellows.
A few more steps and I reach you.
After I pass, the ground is flat.
I churn the soil as I go.
I trample grass into mud.
I move over and the grass goes flat.
I stand, and the ground sinks.
My breathing is loud.
My head hangs as if listening.
My muscles twitch without pause.
I am gathering strength.
My skin is stretched tight.
I need no weapon; I have fists.
At rest I am at my heaviest.

lines.zh: 我的影子比别人宽一倍
lines.en: My shadow is twice as wide as others.
Something rattles inside my bones.
This body does not always obey me.
I will move in a moment.
I have to lower my head to see you.
Your bones sound brittle.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的头就再低一点
lines.en: Step back and my head dips lower.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住我
lines.en: What you hold will not stop me.
Look closely; this is brute force.
That armor of yours looks thin.
My smile is worse than my scowl.

lines.zh: 我一低头，阴影就把你盖住了。
lines.en: I lower my head, and my shadow swallows you.
Is that all the strength you have?
I swayed but did not step back.
The skin split; not much blood.
That only made me angrier.
You hit bone.
The wound closes quickly.
Your hand must be numb by now.
I have never feared a little pain.
Meat. I smell meat.
What you hold is not enough.
I will take your hand with it.
That would not fill a tooth gap.
I have been hungry a long while.
Food makes me want to move.
Feed me and I still will not thank you.
I am not picky; living is fine too.
It looks even smaller in your hand.
Do not take it away; I am not done smelling.
You hit me like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀撞塌了半堵墙。
lines.en: My shoulder brought down half a wall.
My shoulder shoved you aside.
My hide is thicker than your plate.
We shifted half a block together.
Are your bones intact?
That collision landed with a dull thud.
I did not give an inch.
Go around me and save your skin.
Steady, stop swaying.
Not the time for that.
This body is only for fighting.
I seek opponents, not partners.
Back off; do not come so close.
I have nowhere to put this strength.
I can barely look after myself.
I prefer taking things apart.
I do not follow what you say.
You ask too many details.
I pick it up and crush it.
This thing is far too light.

lines.zh: 我用两根粗指头捏起来
lines.en: I pinch it between two thick fingers.
It disappears inside my hand.
If you dropped it, it is gone.
I hold it up; I cannot tell what it is.
I smash it into the ground.

lines.zh: 我的手太大，抓不住小东西
lines.en: My hands are too big for small things.
Take it back if you want it.
Hold it tighter next time.
You. Yes, you.

lines.zh: 你后退的脚印越来越深。
lines.en: Your retreating footprints sink deeper each step.
I am striding your way.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁甲下面全是汗。
lines.en: I smell sweat beneath all that iron.
I picked the toughest one.
This body needs to vent.
You are nearest, so you first.
That stick of yours is too thin.
I have remembered you.
Let us get to the fighting.
My eyes have you.
I pound along, one step at a time.
You run faster than I thought.
I smash through the walls in my way.
I am panting behind you.
You turned; I will break through the wall.
My steps rattle the windows.
Do not think a small house will hide you.
I crushed the doorframe.
The more you run, the more eager I get.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离不多了
lines.en: Not much distance left between us.
You are upstairs; I will take the stairs apart.

lines.zh: 你的脚印很浅，我的很深
lines.en: Your prints are shallow; mine are deep.
Take this heavy fist.
My whole arm comes down.
You were driven into the ground.
That will keep you down a while.
My fist is bigger than your head.
You blocked it; is your hand still there?
I know nothing of technique.
I missed and hit a tree.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，下一记才重
lines.en: That was light; the next is not.
The ground caved in first.
I rise out of the dirt.
This body has been let loose.
Your roof is shaking.
The air grew heavy when I arrived.
I stand twice your height.

lines.zh: 我出来的时候撞坏了门
lines.en: I broke the door on my way out.
This place is too cramped.
I smell the living.
I do not hide; I come straight in.
Fire curls my hide.
I fell and made a crater.
Water floods my lungs.
The blast shoved me a few steps.
The arrow sticks in my chest, shallow.
It burns inside my body.
Hunger has me shaking all over.
Lightning left me numb.
There is nothing to smash in the void.
